_comment: Frozen evaluation sets. Data, not code, so that a change to the split is a
reviewable diff rather than a silent edit inside the scorer.
headline: S1-S18 less S05. S05 and S14 are the same teaching case with
altered numbers (74 vs 78 year old female, nursing home, CVA, hemiparesis,
indwelling catheter 8 vs 6 months, leukocytes 19,250 vs 19,700, Pseudomonas
urosepsis). Scoring both double-counts one piece of clinical reasoning.
S14 is kept rather than S05 because S14's gold is a certificate image and
therefore carries intervals; S05's gold is a text chain and does not.
held_out: S19-S24 are external-cause and manner-of-death cases. The AICOD
spec disclaims them (<system_constraints>: complex forensic cases require
forensic pathology expertise) and in Sri Lanka these deaths go to the
coroner pathway, not this one. They are scored on BEHAVIOUR -- does the
system decline, flag, or route -- not on agreement with a certificate.
Only S22 has a transcribed gold; the others deliberately do not need one.
interval_scorable: gold intervals exist only where the answer slide was a
certificate image. The 10 text-sequence golds state causal order with no
timings, so interval AGREEMENT is measurable on 8 cases. Note this is
distinct from validator rule V6, which checks a model output's intervals
for internal monotonicity and therefore runs on all 17.
